newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Heinz to move NZ cannery to Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Heinz to move NZ cannery to Australia.

text.p: H.J. Heinz Co subsidiary, H.J. Heinz Australia Ltd, will re-locate its recently-acquired meat cannery in New Zealand to Wagga Wagga in the Australian state of New South Wales (NSW), the company said on Friday.
The Shortland, New Zealand, cannery manufactures and markets canned meat products under the Hellaby, Crown and Pacific brands.
The decision to absorb the production into the Southern Country Food facility at Wagga Wagga is aimed at maximising production efficiencies, Heinz Australia said in a statement.
The move will increase production at Wagga Wagga by 25 percent, Peter Hardy, business development officer for Heinz Australia, said.
Wagga Wagga was a world-class facility and support had been received from the NSW government in the move, he said.
Heinz was plannning to spend several million dollars on the existing plant and would employ an additional 15 people, he said. The existing cannery employs 290 people.
Physical changes are expected to begin in April.
